text:
rachel: weekend check: pottery pop-up at the market (Sat 11am) vs microbrew tasting at Foglight (Sat 7pm)? clay or pints? :clay: :beer:

theo: Pottery hands down. been meaning to try wheel throwing. any age limits?

juan: Microbrew for me. new hazy IPA release at Foglight apparently. :drooling_face:

emily: both is tempting. pottery in the day, beers at night, low-effort transit between?

rachel: Market is outdoor, short class slots. Foglight has limited seating so might need reservations.

theo: If anyone wants to carpool, i have 2 seats. leaving at 10:20 for the market.

emily: @theo yes please! also, is the pottery pop-up kid-friendly? thinking of bringing my niece.

juan: The brew tasting is 21+ but they do small-batch sodas too. i can book a table for 6 if we commit. anyone bringing snacks?

rachel: Pottery notes: bring an apron or wear comfy clothes. instructor said "no long sleeves" for wheel. fee is $25 cash.

emily: RSVP: pottery for me (and niece), microbrew maybe depending on table.

theo: RSVP'd for pottery. can do beers after if space.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Pottery Pop-up @ Market" Sat 11:00 AM  RSVP and details: https://calendar.company/events/333333

juan: Ill call Foglight and try to hold a table. will update here. :phone:

emily: GIF: https://giphy.com/pottery-spin.gif :clap:

juan: Foglight says they can reserve a table for 6 at 7:15 if we confirm. ill put a hold under "Juan".

rachel: Vote tally so far: pottery 3, microbrew 1, both 1. leaning pottery + optional beers.

theo: small PSA: wear layers, morning at the market can be chilly.

emily: Also bring cash for the class. merchant is cash-preferred.

rachel: sweet. market meetup 10:50 by the big maple. post-pottery beers are optional but probable. see y'all saturday! :sparkles:
